concept.literalSynthesis: A flat gray pressure plate is built into a compact rope-dart launcher: the plate's plain gray face and the trap's cord-and-dart mechanism remain visibly distinct parts of the same item.
concept.coreMechanic: The primary input channels a single hovering trap toward the cursor; while it remains active it fires one straight dart in the player's facing direction every 0.5 seconds. Each dart deals 5 ranged damage, and the trap expires after 4 seconds, so a full uninterrupted deployment requests about eight darts, subject to runtime spawn limits and successful firing. Releasing primary use makes the trap return. This preserves the source trap's 14-tick use cadence, 4-second life, half-second firing interval, 10-block leash, 30-block/s movement and dart speed, and 5-damage darts. The source items are both white rarity; parent A is a 5,000-copper consumable material/plate and parent B is a 10,010-copper reusable generated item at generation depth 0. Those facts do not establish a progression tier. The generated item is set to white rarity, 15,010 copper and craft yield one to price its two functions; no ammunition or mana is required. Primary use retains the reusable item. Alternate use places the exact gray pressure plate (tile 135, style 2) and spends the item into placement escrow until that tile breaks. The plate remains a separate pressure-plate utility and does not fire darts.
concept.parentAContribution: Parent A supplies the plain gray pressure-plate identity and its exact native placement, tile 135 style 2. The alternate action makes that plate useful as a separate wiring utility; it is not described as having a combat ability.
concept.parentBContribution: Parent B supplies the rope dart trap identity and a deliberate active-use rhythm. Its 14-tick cadence, 4-second trap life, half-second firing beat, 10-block cursor leash and 5-damage ranged darts guide the reusable primary action without implying that the placed plate is a turret.
concept.playerExperience: Hold primary use and steer the cursor to guide the trap; face enemies to send straight darts down a clear line. Releasing returns the trap, and its 4-second life bounds each deployment. Use alternate to place the gray plate; that accepted placement spends this one-item stack until the plate breaks and returns it.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Channel a tethered hovering trap toward the cursor. Keep it active to fire separate straight darts at enemies in the player's facing direction; release to make it return.
Place the exact native gray pressure plate as a separate wiring utility. Accepted placement escrows this generated item until the placed tile breaks and returns it.
